This isn’t just another travel vlog. This is a once-in-a-lifetime experience where we got to -
• Explore the Laxmi Vilas Palace, the world’s largest private residence
• Meet Her Highness Maharani Radhikaraje Gaekwad inside the palace
• Play Heritage Garba with 20-30,000 people under the night sky
• Experience the aarti and temple rituals up close
• Visit Gazra Café - Gujarat’s first transgender-run café, right on palace grounds
• Discover the deeper meaning of Garba
